'''Ushallaj''' was a [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as a [[Private/Legends|private]] in the [[Republic Army]] aboard the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] [[Carrick Station]], selling combat gear during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Ushallaj first appeared in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]], as a PvP Ranked Gear Vendor for the trooper. Ushallaj's appearance and gear was changed with the release of Game Update 2.0, when the elder game gear system was overhauled. He was later removed in Game Update 5.0 on [[November 29]], [[2016]], which retired the PvP and PvE gear vendors in favor of the Command system.
